description: This file defines the React functional component `PermissionsModalWrapper` which manages the display logic for a permissions modal within a web application. It handles state management, callback setup, and integration with the application's event system.

classes.name: PermissionsModalWrapper
classes.description: React functional component wrapping permissions modal logic, managing dialog state and event subscriptions.

methods.name: presentPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Sets the current permission dialog to be displayed.

methods.name: dismissPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Clears the current permission dialog, dismissing it.

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Assigns the presentPermissionsDialog function to the application's component manager when the app starts.
